name: Article 7, § 3 – 48
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text: 3. Alternatively to paragraphs 1, and 2, an operator shall receive financial support from the Fund provided that the operator demonstrates to the satisfaction of the Commission, that it has made a legal commitment within the meaning of Article 3d of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/1842 made for investments to achieve the targets and milestones referred to in a climate neutrality plan and which is at least equivalent to the support amount applied for under this Regulation.
